look: Warm cream, honey and toasted brown tones, soft morning light, a small neighbourhood bakery in Nairobi, honest and unfussy

images.brief: A two-tier celebration cake with cream frosting and fresh berries on a cake stand, on a wooden table in a bakery

images.brief: The front of a small bakery shop on a leafy street at morning, an open wooden door, a chalkboard stand without writing, potted plants
